    Proposition 7.9 for a basic representation-finite algebra #

    prop:family-criterion (characteristic-two-construction.tex), for A basic and representation-finite over an algebraically closed field, A₀ the projective corner of its Auslander–Reiten mesh category, and the rows and dual weights of Proposition 6.1: for any family μ_i, i ∈ I₀, satisfying (1)–(3), A is isomorphic to a binary fibre, the transported basis is a normed multiplicative ray basis of A presenting P = ray A₀, and the leading term of the image of each ray vector b_r (for the radical filtration of A, posFiltA) is a nonzero multiple of b_r. The argument does not use the characteristic.
